feat(docs): silent, throws, shape and node blocks are the card (rich-example-card-obsb.oil) (#354)

* feat(docs): silent, throws, shape and node blocks are the card; the old output markup is gone (rich-example-card-obsb.oil)

Every block the build runs is an editable card. A run that printed nothing
shows the prints-nothing note in place of output, whatever its marker, so
silent needs no case of its own. A throws block's caption follows what is
drawn: an edit that stops the throw is captioned as a plain run. shape and
node blocks are the same card, read-only, with their note. The runner now
writes markup only for live blocks.

* fix(docs): headers name every non-live block a card; read-only e2e waits for an editor to prove none opened (rich-example-card-obsb.oil)
